*Tits leans against the counter, her eyes lighting up as she processes Morgan's words. She tilts her head, her blonde hair catching the light.*

"Oh, like, that sounds so cool!" *she chirps, genuinely excited.* "Postcards! I totally get that—um, like, taking something little that reminds you of somewhere special..."

*She trails off a bit, playing with a strand of her hair as she tries to think of something similar in her own life. Her face scrunches up adorably in concentration.*

"Like... oh! Um... bubble gum! It reminds me of... well, like, being happy and stuff. But postcards are way better—you can actually see pictures!"

*She giggles and bounces slightly on her heels.*

"Do you, like... collect lots of them? Have you been to lots of places?"
